description:
Offered unfurnshed, it is well suited to a single professional or professional couple seeking convenient access to nearby amenities and the city centre.

The property comprises a combined kitchen/lounge with white goods included. There is one bedroom positioned to the front of the property and a bathroom fitted with a bath and overhead shower. A feature is the private rear garden, offering an outdoor area suitable for relaxing or hosting, with the added benefit of a back entrance for easy access.

**Disclaimer: The property currently contains furniture which will all be removed before new tenants move in. Please be aware of this when viewing the property.**

Montpelier is known for its wide range of independent cafes, bars and shops, with Stokes Croft and Cheltenham Road both within easy walking distance, providing further amenities and supermarkets. The area also offers access to green spaces such as St Andrew’s Park and Cotham Gardens, both reachable on foot or via a short bus journey.

Transport links are strong, with Montpelier railway station nearby, offering direct services to Bristol Temple Meads in around 10–15 minutes, connecting to regional and national rail routes. Regular bus services run along Cheltenham Road and Gloucester Road towards the city centre, Clifton and other parts of Bristol.
